headline: 蜘蛛侠新片领跑，今日零上映
headlineEn: Spider-Man new film leads, zero releases today
summary: 今日零新片上映，本周共6部新作。电影热搜由《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》《奥德赛》《小黄人与大怪兽》领跑，剧集《Ted Lasso》《痴迷》同样入榜。待映新片《逃出绝命街》《OK老板娘2》备受期待。
summaryEn: No new films released today, with 6 new films this week. Movie trends are led by Spider-Man: Brand New Day, The Odyssey, and Minions and the Big Monster, while Ted Lasso and Obsession also chart. Upcoming titles Escape from Deadly Street and OK! Madam 2 are highly anticipated.
